text:
riley: Heads-up team — target publish for the v1.8 announcement is tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URL, and benchmark hero PNG by EOD so we can finalize the blog + social tiles.
devin: Working on the changelog now. PR will include canonical docs path and the KV cache migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/451
ana: (typo) meant to be @ana — design deadline acknowledged. Clare can you confirm PNG ETA?
clare: I can get hero + 3 social variants by 18:30 if I get the raw chart CSV by 15:30. Also need short alt text + single-line benchmark copy.
sre: Bench numbers uploaded to the PR comments. Short suggested line: "~18% per-token efficiency improvement vs prior release; p95 latency remains comparable." Use that or tweak.
riley: Good. Marketing prefers "per-token efficiency improvement" phrasing instead of 'savings'. Lock that in across channels.
devin: Docs canonical URL will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v1.8/overview — adding anchor for migration + a micro runbook link.
infra-bot: CI: changelog PR checks passed (unit tests + docs lint).
devin: Added migration snippet to docs (also pasted below):
```
# self-hosted example
redwood.runtime.cache.kv_enabled = true
redwood.runtime.batch.max_items = 64
```
sre: Please add a short pre/post upgrade checklist link for support. I added runbook anchor: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/v1.8-upgrade#precheck
crm-bot: Inbound routing plan ready — leads will be tagged "ann_v1_8" and forwarded to queue "marketing_releases" in SFDC. Webhook URL: https://hooks.redwood.com/crm/releases
ana: Webinar team confirms live Q&A slot next Thu and on-demand recording URL. Add both CTAs?
riley: Yes — include both. Live sign-up above the fold, recording link under Resources. Sign-up: https://redwood.com/events/v1-8-live  Recording: https://redwood.com/events/v1-8/recording
clare: Got the CSV and SRE blurb; hero PNG and social images will be uploaded to the PR by 18:15. I will attach alt text and suggested tweet copy.
devin: One more — avoid publishing raw config in the marketing copy. Link to the migration runbook instead.
riley: Agreed. We'll link to runbook and include one-line migration note: "Self-hosted customers: follow the upgrade checklist for KV cache config changes."
sre: Canary plan for prod deploy: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m health windows. infra-bot will post progress.
infra-bot: staging deploy success 2024-11-05T20:02:14Z. prod scheduled 2024-11-06 08:30 PT.
devin: Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commit/1234abcd  — includes canonical doc link and redirect rules.
clare: Assets uploaded: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/451/files (hero/png + social) — will export social sizes in the morning.
crm-bot: SFDC mapping applied. Lead tag: ann_v1_8. Webhook tested.
riley: Great — I will schedule the post for 09:00 PT and will not publish until canary reaches 10% and health checks pass. If anything blocks, flag here within the next hour. :hourglass: 
ana: LGTM on docs and runbook.
devin: No blockers from eng; monitoring looks good.
infra-bot: prod canary started 2024-11-06T08:30:02Z — 1% traffic.
sre: Canary healthy at 1% after 10m. progressing to 10%.
riley: Once canary is at 10% and green I'll publish and ping support for inbound lead handling. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
